report.summary: Found 1 review-recommended dependency drift issue: the new Redis-backed session store is not represented in app.tm.hcl.

findings.title: Redis session store is absent from third-party dependency assertions

evidence.note: Adds the previously unmodeled github.com/redis/go-redis/v9 dependency.
Creates a client connection to an external Redis instance.
Stores session tokens and user IDs in Redis with a 24-hour TTL.

relevance.justification: Strongly relevant because Redis is both a new third-party dependency and the external store for the model's Restricted session-token asset, but only the identity provider is currently modeled.

findings.agent_prompt: Update app.tm.hcl in threat model "login service" by adding a `third_party_dependency "Redis"` block with an appropriate `uptime_dependency` value and a description stating that Redis is the shared store for restricted session tokens and user IDs with a 24-hour TTL. This is required because go.mod adds github.com/redis/go-redis/v9 at go.mod:6, internal/session/cache.go creates a Redis client at line 17, and stores session-token-to-user-ID mappings at line 22; the model currently lists only the identity provider at app.tm.hcl:23.
findings.suggested_fix: Add a Redis third-party dependency block describing its use as the shared session-token store and its uptime dependency.
